skills.desc:
Activate Lunatic status Charge on user (3 turns)
* Charge: For each hit (including damage to self), add Thunder-type attack (XS)
** Attack type is determined by the original attack
** Regardless of whether there is an active Stance or not, each additional attack increases AF bar by 0.5% and combo multiplier in AF by 1%
** If the original attack was absorbed, extra attacks will not hit but will still increase AF bar and combo multiplier
** Not affected by Kaleido
* Replaces the basic attack until used (1 activation)
* When Another Force has been used at least once: Magic critical damage of user +10% (3 turns)
** Buff effect increases +10% per additional AF use (Max 5 times, +50%)
* When not in AF and 3 God-Like Power stacked: Restore 50% of the AF gauge and consumes all stacks
